generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted and tender is of two cover system.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in e-Procurement, may now obtain the same from the website www.eproc.karnataka.gov.in

Corrigendum/ modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification on e- Procurement, contact the office of the Executive Engineer (O&M)Bhadra, Bhadra Generating Station, KPCL, B.R.Project,577115, Bhadravathi - Tq, Shimoga - Dist, Karnataka, Mob No.:9449598814
Section I, II, III, Instruction to bidders, Form of Bid, and Self declaration are part of the Tender document.
After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose offer meet the PQR and technical specification of the tender/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened.

Prices for each item specified in work estimate shall be uploaded in the e-portal itself. Prices will be evaluated based on the rates quoted in the e-portal i.e., the sum total price of items forming the total bid amount.

Note: Rates per unit quoted shall be FOR destination basis and inclusive of packing forwarding, loading, unloading, transportation, freight and insurance charges and any other allowances and exclusive of GST.
Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason is reserved by the undersigned.
The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only. The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes as per the latest GOK/GOI orders.
The quantity of materials and work mentioned/indicated in tender may vary depending on the final requirement at the time of placing the work order.

Bidders are advised to visit the work site at Bhadra Generating Station before bidding to obtain the hands-on information if required about the quantum of work and supply involved from the concerned division head. Further, post tender correspondences regarding technical specification, scope of work and supply involved will not be entertained and it is the responsibility of the bidders to get any queries cleared before bidding for subject work.

KPCL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any or all the certificates furnished by any or all the tenders from the authorities who have issued the same. If it is found that any of the agency/agencies have furnished false certificates/ information, the tenders submitted by them are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have proven experience for being successfully carried out the work of Erection, Testing & Commissioning Transformers of capacity 9MVA and above in power utilities / reputed organizations. In proof of the above, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of work order and corresponding work completion/work done certificate for at least one single order for preceding 5 years towards the execution of similar work for above said work with contract value not less than Rs. 5.25 Lakh issued from competent authority.

itemList.description:
Shifting of existing scrap 9MVA, 66KV/11KV transformer from spare transformer to KPCL New store. 
a. Transportation of Transformer, CTs, PTs, Breakers, C&R Panels, 11 kV Switchgears and EHT LAs only. Using 21 MT to 40 MT Truck & Trailor Greater than 250 km as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Shifting of existing scrap 9MVA, 66KV/11KV transformer from spare transformer to KPCL New store.
b) Loading of Power Transformers, CTs, PTs, Breakers, C&R Panels, 11 kV Switchgears, Wave Trap, Coupling Capacitors, HT UG Cables, Insulators, ACSR Conductor, Ground Conductor, etc., as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Shifting of existing scrap 9MVA, 66KV/11KV transformer from spare transformer to KPCL New store.
c) Unloading of Power Transformers, CTs, PTs, Breakers, C&R Panels, 11 kV Switchgears, Wave Trap, Coupling Capacitors, HT UG Cables, Insulators, ACSR Conductor, Ground Conductor, etc., as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Shifting of existing scrap 9MVA, 66KV/11KV transformer from spare transformer to KPCL New store.
d) Crane hiring charges for Sub-station works Greater than 5 hours as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dismantling of 15 MVA 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer from Switch Yard to Repair Bay.
a) Moving the Transformer from switch yard to repair bay. Maximum allowable distance is 50 metre as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dismantling of 15 MVA 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer from Switch Yard to Repair Bay.
b) Assembly/dismantling of Transformer parts like bushings, cooler, NCT,filling oil into Tr. etc., for the total weight of the Transformer as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dismantling of 15 MVA 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer from Switch Yard to Repair Bay.
c) Wiring of Transformer marshalling box, bucholtz relay, fixing thermometer, OLTC upto control panel and assisting in testing and commissioning by RT/MT/Firm Engineers 10 MVA to 20 MVA Transformer as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works. 
a) Moving the Transformer from repair bay to switch yard Maximum allowable distance is 50 metre as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works.
b) Assembly of Transformer parts like bushings, radiators, filling oil into Tr. etc., for the total weight of the Transformer as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works. 
c) Filtration of oil using filter set of the contractor to bring the insulation value to I.E. specification as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works.
d) Wiring of Transformer marshalling box, bucholtz relay, fixing thermometer, OLTC upto control panel and assisting in testing and commissioning by RT/MT/Firm Engineers 10 MVA to 20 MVA Transformer as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works.
e) Inspection of wires and ferrules. Inspection of wiring of protective devices, cooling fans, OLTC, bushing, etc., as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works. 
f) Testing of 9 MVA Transformer as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works.
g) Supervising and Commissioning of Transformer as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works.
h) Supply, Laying and Termination of 72.5KV rated Lynx Conductor using required quantity of connectors (Wedge, C Wedge, Padel connector) for HV 3phases for newly supplied 9 MVA transformers complete as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Dragging of New 9MVA, 66KV/11KV Generator Transformer supplied by M/s Vijay Electric Co make approx 50 meters with 2 times wheel direction change including Erection, Testing & Commissioning works. 
i) Dismantling and modification of Mulsifyre system as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.
